## Rights of Learners

::: {.callout}
[The right to be confused.]{style="color:red"}
:::

::: {.callout}
[The right to say what makes sense to you.]{style="color:blue"}
:::

::: {.callout}
[The right to make mistakes.]{style="color:green"}
:::

::: {.callout}
[The right to share unfinished thinking and not be judged.]{style="color:purple"}
:::

::: {.callout}
[The right to revise your thinking.]{style="color:orange"}
:::
